name: deduction guides for std::pair

declarations.code:
template <class T1, class T2>

pair(T1, T2) -> pair<T1, T2>;

intro: One deduction guide is provided for std::pair to account for the edge cases missed by the implicit deduction guides, in particular, non-copyable arguments and array to pointer conversion.
